features: [Efficient charging capacity]: With its ample 10000mAh battery capacity, the ZEB-MB10000S15 power bank ensures rapid and efficient charging, minimizing waiting time effectively.
[Output power]: Capable of charging various compatible devices, the power bank can provide an output of 22.5W.
[Multiple outputs]: Distinguished by its DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A dual USB output
DC 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A, 12V/1.85A, 3.8~11V/2A PPS Type-C output, the ZEB-MB10000S15 enables simultaneous charging of 3 devices, offering a convenient solution for rapidly powering up multiple gadgets.

[Rapid charging]: By embracing advanced charging standards and providing options like DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A type-C input, DC 5V/2A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A Micro USB input, the ZEB-MB10000S15 ensures rapid charging.
[Classy design]: The ZEB-MB10000S15 showcases a matte finish design, elevating its aesthetic appeal.
[Safety protection]: The ZEB-MB10000S15 places safety as a top priority, incorporating overcharge, overload, and short-circuit protection mechanisms to ensure a safe charging process.
[LED display]: Featuring an LED percentage display, this power bank provides information on the remaining battery capacity.
description: Introducing the ZEB-MB10000S15 power bank, a reliable companion for your charging needs. With its robust 10000mAh battery capacity and rapid charging capabilities, it ensures swift and efficient power delivery. Featuring versatile input options including Type-C and Micro USB, alongside dual USB outputs, it offers flexibility in charging various devices. Safety is paramount with built-in protections against short circuits, overcharges, and overloads. With a maximum output of 22.5W and PD 3.0 Type C output, it efficiently charges multiple devices. Stay informed with the LED percentage display, while the matte finish adds a sleek touch to its design.
